body:
# NewifyShulker
[简体中文](https://github.com/chenjunfu2/NewifyShulker/blob/master/README.md)  
**Make used shulker boxes new again.**  

## Compatibility with Stacking Mods
This mod can be used together with mods that allow shulker box stacking (e.g., Carpet (server-side) or Tweakeroo (client-only)) to enable used shulker boxes to stack with new ones.  

## How It Works
The mod works by intercepting the shulker box item entity when it drops upon breaking, and removing unnecessary NBT tags.  

## Requirements
**Game Version**: **``Minecraft 1.20.1``**  
**Loader Version**: **``Fabric 0.16.10+``**  
**Multiplayer**:  Only need to install on **``Server``**  
**Singleplayer**: Only need to install on **``Client``**
